parsed.explanation: Structural signals dominate despite thin trans-specific data. Gender presentation is criminalised (Art 152) in a conflict-affected state with no legal gender recognition, no documented relief, and authorities implicated in extrajudicial killings and torture of LGBT people, plus vigilante violence and pervasive social hostility (only 17% tolerance even for homosexuality). This is tier-2 state-tolerated/targeting territory with tier-5 outcomes documented against the closest analogues, so thin-data extrapolation resolves toward severe risk rather than the midpoint. Mitigation: the 2020 repeal of capital punishment and flogging for sodomy removes the worst paper penalty; Art 152's enforcement against visitors is unsourced and no executions were documented pre-repeal. But no protective machinery, no community infrastructure beyond a single remaining group, and documented lethal state violence hold this at the top of the severe band, comparable to profiles with organised state coercion short of near-certain execution (0.15 anchors).
